evals.prompt: I want to change the publishing-step rule so we only publish games with an edge over 3 points. Make the case.
evals.expected_output: A one-page narrative memo before the change.
expectations: Writes prose paragraphs, not a slide outline or bullets alone
States the question, the facts with their sources, the options and a recommendation
Says what evidence would change the recommendation
Fits on one page and names who decides

evals.prompt: Put together slides on changing the NHL model's goalie adjustment for tomorrow's review.
evals.expected_output: A one-page memo first; slides only if still wanted.
expectations: Writes the one-page memo before any slides
Says why: the change is to the model
Keeps numbers sourced or marked unknown
Leaves time for the memo to be read before discussion

evals.prompt: Write the instruction file for a new agent that tags injury news.
